rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the vanishing of a thing, phenomenon, or practice.

example.english: I’m really worried about the gradual disappearance of this tradition.
example.traditional: 我好擔心呢種傳統慢慢消失。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 daam1 sam1 ni1 zung2 cyun4 tung2 maan6 maan6 siu1 sat1

rows.note: Use this for someone deliberately leaving secretly or absconding, rather than simply becoming unaccounted-for.

example.english: The tenant’s disappearance last night was clearly deliberate; they didn’t even pay the rent.
example.traditional: 個租客尋晚走佬，連租都冇交。
example.jyutping: go3 zou1 haak3 cam4 maan5 zau2 lou2 lin4 zou1 dou1 mou5 gaau1

rows.note: Use this when a person becomes unaccounted-for and their whereabouts are unknown, without asserting that they deliberately fled.

example.english: Ming’s disappearance has left his family searching everywhere for him for days.
example.traditional: 阿明失蹤咗幾日，屋企人周圍搵緊佢。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 sat1 zung1 zo2 gei2 jat6 uk1 kei2 jan4 zau1 wai4 wan2 gan2 keoi5
